title: Shard lifecycle: spawn, join/leave, save, reap
description: Complete the shard lifecycle around the router: join/leave presence broadcasts, initial snapshot handshake, graceful shutdown of the whole server (flush all active shards), and leak detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Join: client receives hello-ok → auth → join_system → {code:'joined', systemId, snapshot: EntityState[]} within one round-trip; all existing connections receive presence_join {callsign} (TASK-15 consumes this)
Leave: disconnecting triggers presence_leave; the player's ship remains in the shard (abandoned ships are not reaped — they persist per TASK-24)
Graceful shutdown (SIGTERM/SIGINT): all active shards flushShips (TASK-24) before the process exits; exit code 0; DB contains all ship states
Leak test: 100 join/leave cycles across 5 systems leave exactly 0 active shards and 0 open DB handles (assert via process._getActiveHandles or the repo's open-transaction counter)
Reconnect storm: 16 clients join the same system, all leave, 10 rejoin within 2 s — shard is reused (same uptime, no reload from DB mid-flight; asserted via a shard generation counter)

steps.details: shard.addConnection: push to conns, send snapshot, broadcast presence_join. removeConnection: remove, broadcast presence_leave, start reap grace via router. Initial snapshot = current entity list (full, not diffed) — v1 keeps it simple.

server/main.ts: process.on('SIGTERM'/'SIGINT') → router.shutdownAll(): for each shard flushShips (await), sim.stop(); close repo; exit 0. 10 s watchdog: if shutdown exceeds it, force exit 1 with an error log.
Join/leave cycle test with handle counting; reconnect storm test asserting shard reuse via a generation counter on the shard object. Run full suite.

technicalNotes: Abandoned ships stay dockable: a ship left in flight remains in the sim (idle, no inputs) — players can fly away and come back to it. Document this in TASK-69 FAQ.
Shard generation counter: increments per (re)load from DB; the router never reloads while connections exist, only on fresh spawn.
